verdict.rationale: Twilio offers conversational-AI and agent features, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence only documents Twilio's own MCP server, which exposes Twilio's API to coding agents. That is the server role and does not show Twilio can connect to or use tools from other MCP servers, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
